dialogues.speaker: Hawad
dialogues.text: I guess I'll rest around the pitstop once I'm done here.

dialogues.speaker: Hawad
dialogues.text: Too bad I can't see that flower again...

dialogues.speaker: Hawad
dialogues.text: Hello, I'm a traveling merchant who sells desert specialties. Unfortunately, I only brought a few items with me this time, and they've been booked.

dialogues.speaker: Hawad
dialogues.text: But if you're interested, you can take a look for the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Hawad
dialogues.text: Ajilenakh Nuts have been the most in demand lately.

dialogues.speaker: Hawad
dialogues.text: Ajilenakh Nuts are a common crop that the people of the desert used to plant. They make pretty good desserts and candy because of their high sugar content.

dialogues.speaker: Hawad
dialogues.text: Sweets make people happy, so I guess that's where its popularity comes from.

dialogues.speaker: Hawad
dialogues.text: I heard researchers from the Akademiya are even trying to find out which type of light produces sweeter Ajilenakh Nuts. I really look forward to their results.

dialogues.speaker: Hawad
dialogues.text: Ah... I mean a girl from here. She is the flower of this place. I only have to look at her smile from a distance and I feel cleansed already.

dialogues.speaker: Hawad
dialogues.text: But I heard that she's gone to Sumeru City to look for her lover.

dialogues.speaker: Hawad
dialogues.text: What a pity... I don't even know her name...

dialogues.speaker: Hawad
dialogues.text: I won? Uh... Thanks for going easy on me, dear guest?

dialogues.speaker: Hawad
dialogues.text: You're really good! If I had your skills, I'd be able to talk business with just about anyone!
